query: I run a small warehouse. Preparing the first 10 boxes costs EUR 2 per box, the next 10 cost EUR 1.50 each, and any additional boxes cost EUR 1 each. These are progressive rates: each rate applies only to its own portion. Add a single EUR 5 shipping charge when there is at least one box. With no boxes, charge nothing. Only whole, non-negative numbers of boxes are allowed; reject fractions, negative amounts and entries that are not numbers of boxes. How much should I charge to prepare and ship 27 boxes?
